title: teucrium scorodonia subsp. euganeum
intro: Teucrium scorodonia subsp. euganeum, commonly known as Italian wood sorrel, is a subspecies of the Teucrium scorodonia plant, belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the prevention and treatment of various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Italian wood sorrel include its ability to support the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which have been identified in the plant's leaves and other parts.
